name: Octree-based Regular Grid Hierarchy
aliases: Octree-based LOD with Out-of-Core Rendering (Leven et al.)
Octree-based Regular Grid Hierarchy (Leven et al.)
definition: A technique that converts an unstructured grid into a hierarchy of regular grids stored in an octree, managing resampling, filtering, and rendering out-of-core.
summary: Octree-based Regular Grid Hierarchy converts unstructured grids into octree-organized regular grids for texture-based LOD rendering, distinguishing itself by using structured hierarchies and out-of-core management to mitigate memory explosion.
